desc: Ideation: prove that an even interval’s optimum equals sum of its largest half minus sum of its smallest half, and that for odd N the unmatched survivor must be at an odd 1-based position.
Implement complete Python solution with two-heap prefix/suffix computation and stdin/stdout handling.
Test the solution on the provided samples and edge cases (N=2, all equal, odd/even extremes) and optionally against brute force for small N.
